goal:
For a talk on Wikipedia's early history I want to know when the English article "Eiffel Tower" was created. Its revision history is here: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Eiffel_Tower&action=history
On what date was its first revision made? Please tell me where you found it.
